description: This source file defines a helper class for security-related testing in the PdfSharp library, including enums for encryption options, test data configurations, and methods for applying security settings to PDF documents and managing test file naming conventions.

classes.name: SecurityTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing constants, enums, and methods for testing PDF security features, including encryption configuration and test file management.

methods.name: SecureDocument
methods.description: Applies security settings to a PdfDocument based on specified encryption options.

methods.name: AddPrefixToFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename prefix based on encryption options for test file naming.

methods.name: AddSuffixToFilename
methods.description: Generates a filename suffix based on encryption options for test file naming.

methods.name: GetFilenamePrefix
methods.description: Constructs a prefix string for filenames based on encryption options.

methods.name: GetAssetsTestFile
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate test file path based on encryption options and passwords.
